question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**especially**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The blank requires an adverb that emphasizes the significance or specificity of the statement being discussed.
 
• The word "especially" highlights something that is of particular importance or relevance in the context.
 
• Other options like "ascetically", "equally", and "fanatically" do not fit the context or meaning intended in the sentence.
 
• "**Especially**" is the most appropriate choice to fill the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Ascetically (संयमपूर्वक): "Ascetically" refers to self-discipline or abstention, which does not fit the context.
 
• Equally (समान रूप से): "Equally" means in equal measure, which does not emphasize the importance or relevance as required.
 
• Fanatically (कट्टरता से): "Fanatically" means with excessive enthusiasm or zeal, which is unrelated to the passage.
